headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The MLB saw several exciting games on June 30, 2026, with the Orioles, Guardians, Nationals, Tigers, Pirates, and Reds securing victories. 

Top MLB news saw the Orioles cruise past the White Sox 6-1, with Dean Kremer earning the win. The Guardians took down the Rangers 9-4, led by Austin Hedges' home run and three RBIs. The Nationals dominated the Red Sox 10-2, with James Wood leading the offense. The Tigers secured a 6-2 victory over the Yankees, with Keider Montero earning the win. The Pirates took down the Phillies 6-1, with several players making significant contributions. The Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Brewers, led by strong performances from TJ Friedl and Dane Myers.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jason Adam (San Diego Padres) and his placement on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain. Mitchell Parker (Washington Nationals) was transferred to the 60-day injured list with left elbow inflammation. Matt Chapman (San Francisco Giants) was placed on the 10-day injured list with an abdominal strain. Kris Bubic (Kansas City Royals) and Connor Seabold (Kansas City Royals) were both placed on the injured list due to left elbow soreness and a right lat strain, respectively. Corey Seager (Texas Rangers) was placed on the 10-day injured list with lower back inflammation. Will Vest (Detroit Tigers) was placed on the 15-day injured list with right posterior elbow inflammation. Connelly Early (Boston Red Sox) was placed on the 15-day injured list with left elbow inflammation.

The MLB saw several trades and roster movements, including the Washington Nationals acquiring Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles for Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen. The Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The San Francisco Giants traded 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners for cash.

top_news.title: **Orioles Cruise Past White Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dean Kremer earning the win. Sam Antonacci led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Noah Schultz pitched 4.1 innings with 7 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Rangers 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Austin Hedges leading the offense. Hedges hit a home run and drove in three runs, while Joey Cantillo earned the win with 5 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Keider Montero earning the win. Kevin McGonigle led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with several players making significant contributions to the win. Jake Mangum, Brandon Lowe, Esmerlyn Valdez, Nick Gonzales, and Endy Rodríguez were among the impact hitters for the Pirates, while Jared Jones stood out as a key pitcher.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, led by strong performances from key players. Impact hitters for the Reds included TJ Friedl and Dane Myers, while Jacob Misiorowski stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Padres' Jason Adam Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres right-handed pitcher Jason Adam has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain, effective retroactive to June 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade from the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.
